title: Monuments and Memorials Night Walking Tour
includes: ✅ Walking Tour of Major Monuments & Memorials
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the National Mall like never before on this enchanting night tour. A journey from the illuminated Washington Monument to the glowing Lincoln Memorial, passing iconic landmarks such as the World War II Memorial and Vietnam Veterans Memorial, all beautifully lit against the night sky. This evening adventure offers a unique and breathtaking perspective on American history, framed by stunning architecture and powerful tributes that shine even brighter after dark.
